purpose: Paired OpenCode/Harness executor comparison on cost per validated candidate.
rules: Each task is run once per executor from the same base commit, goal, and validation plan.
Verifiers live outside the attempt worktree. A worker must never be able to read the acceptance criteria instead of solving the task.
Validation must exercise the task's own deliverable. A plan that passes without testing what was asked for makes first-pass rate optimistic for both executors.
Validation must reject a plausible wrong answer, not merely a missing file.
No task may be edited after either executor has run it. If a task proves defective, discard the pair and restart it.
None of these tasks may be used for provider or measurement calibration; that uses a separate throwaway task.

tasks.goal: Create TOTALS.md containing one line per row of inventory.csv in the form '<item>: <qty>', then a final line 'Total: <sum>' with the arithmetic sum of the qty column.
Create CHEAP.md listing only the items from catalog.csv whose price is strictly below 5.00, one per line as '<item> <price>', sorted by price ascending.
tasks.shape: filter and sort with a boundary condition

tasks.goal: Read config.json and write config.summary.json containing an object with keys 'services' (the count of entries in the services array) and 'ports' (an ascending array of every distinct port used).
The function lastIndex in src/lib.js returns the wrong value for non-empty arrays. Fix it so it returns the index of the final element, and leave every other function unchanged.
tasks.shape: localized bug fix with regression risk

tasks.goal: Add an exported function named median to src/lib.js that returns the median of an array of numbers, averaging the two middle values for even-length input and returning null for an empty array. Do not modify existing functions.
tasks.shape: additive API change with edge cases

tasks.goal: Rename the exported function tally in src/lib.js to countItems, updating every reference across src/ so all modules still load and existing behaviour is preserved.

Create API.md with one '## <name>' section per exported function in src/lib.js. Each section must contain a line 'Parameters: <names>' listing its parameter names and a line 'Returns: <description>' describing what it returns.
Create notes.clean.md from notes.md with every line trimmed of trailing whitespace, all blank runs collapsed to a single blank line, and the original line order preserved.
Create REPORT.md joining inventory.csv and catalog.csv on the item name, one line per item present in both as '<item> <qty> x <price> = <total>' with total rounded to two decimals.
tasks.shape: join across two sources with computation

tasks.goal: Add a trailing newline and a final line '# end' to notes.md without altering any existing line of that file.
tasks.shape: minimal edit under a strict no-collateral constraint

notes: The runner resolves <VERIFIER_ROOT> to an absolute path outside the attempt worktree and runs the command with the worktree as the working directory.
A relative validate command is deliberately not stored here: it would encode an assumption about where the worktree sits relative to the verifiers, which does not hold for a real attempt worktree.
